# go-link-monitor on the rocm-ernic virtual ionic NIC, per profile

Each column is one guest: the in-tree ionic and ionic_rdma drivers bound to rocm-ernic with the given `--nic-profile`, a TAP peer, ping and TCP SYN traffic from every vCPU, and an RDMA RC ping-pong attempt. The values are what go-link-monitor exported; the driver's own view (ethtool, ip -s link, sysfs) is beside each guest's scrapes.

## compat

netdev `eth0`, RDMA device `ionic_0`, 8 vCPUs, `--nic-profile compat`.

Nonzero RDMA hw_counters: `commands` 73, `total_bytes_received` 4,096,000, `total_bytes_sent` 4,096,000.
